text:
noah: quick sync on compact-playground tweaks. attached new frames — main things: streaming stop behavior, token pill verbosity, prompt quick-insert keyboard support. looking for accessibility + copy nits before I lock the figma.

eve: looked good. biggest UX question: what does "Stop" mean? users assumed it discards partial output in previous tests. can we make it explicit without being wordy?

kai: proposal: keep primary button "Stop" and show a tiny caption: "Stops stream. Partial output retained for regenerate or edit." Caption is visible on hover/tap for discoverability.

noah: that caption works. also for mobile long-press we surface "Discard" as an option. avoid the term "abort".

ben: token counter: voiceover / NVDA spam when number increases. recommend debounce 250ms + aria-live="polite" for updates, and aria-live="assertive" for final messages like "generation stopped".

accessibility-bot: note: token pill contrast fails WCAG at 10px. bump bg or use outline on focus. Also make pill hit target >=44px for touch.

eve: spinner while we reconcile server token count is nice. show small spinner in pill and set aria-hidden=true on the animated number until stable.

kai: telemetry: unify to \`playground.interrupt\` with enum method {"stop","discard","regen"}. sample: ```js
telemetry.track('playground.interrupt', { method: 'stop', tokens_seen: 18, variant: 'compact-v3' })
```

noah: prompt library: keyboard nav needs work. ensure prompt items are focusable, Enter inserts, Space pins. add visually-hidden label "Insert prompt: <title>". change card title to "Prompt library" instead of "Saved prompts".

ben: microcopy tweak: tooltip for regen -> "Regenerate from start 1 (replaces partial output)" maybe too technical. simpler: "Regenerate full response".

kai: flagged potential billing regression: regen while stream teardown overlaps causes double-count in dedicated mode. filing ticket INF-9400 and adding client-side regen lock + server idempotency key.

accessibility-bot: created quick test checklist: voiceover debounce pass, keyboard nav for prompt library, focus ring check in both themes.

eve: dev handoff checklist: caption under stop, token debounce + spinner, pill hit-area, aria-live rules, prompt keyboard + hidden labels, copy changes, telemetry event change, INF-9400 for dedupe.

noah: i'll update figma and open PR tomorrow. anyone object?

kai: no objections. I'll prototype spinner + local lock.

ben: I'll run a11y pass once PR is up. thanks :thumbsup:

noah: staging build flag compact-playground enabled at 2215010000. pinning landing checklist in thread.
